purpose: R35 first-50 BEHAVIOR use_skill:false SFT under the R34 effective-batch fix (RLinf now rank-disjoint, effective batch 256) on 8 GPUs, evaluated against the reference production curve r24 on the DEC-1(b) gate.

run.command: python examples/sft/train_vla_sft.py --config-name behavior_pi05_vla runner.max_steps=60 (8x A800, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0-7, seed 42, use_skill:false, turning_on_radio, FSDP FULL_SHARD bf16, the R34 fix at git 729c48d1)

before_vs_after.note: the pre-fix RLinf (effective batch 32) descended systematically ~2x below the reference (step49 0.046 vs 0.090); under the fix (effective batch 256) RLinf TRACKS the reference (step49 0.0826 vs 0.090, |Δ|=0.0078) and within-0.03 rises 30->40/50.

verdict: ROOT CAUSE RESOLVED, NOT a strict 50/50. The R34 effective-batch fix eliminates the SYSTEMATIC first-50 divergence: under the fix RLinf descends LIKE the reference (step49 0.0826 vs 0.0903, |Δ|=0.0078; overall mean 0.1552 vs 0.1675; first-5 0.2460 vs 0.2430) — vs the pre-fix RLinf's systematic ~2x-lower curve (step49 0.046). within-0.03 rises 30/50 -> 40/50. The remaining 10/50 outliers are EARLY-step + run-to-run noise/time-RNG + data-ordering differences (RLinf and the reference sample flow-matching noise/time INDEPENDENTLY and shuffle independently; the step-0 |Δ|=0.055 on identical base weights is purely that), NOT a systematic divergence — consistent with the reference's own ~0.004 run-to-run variance (R24) being amplified at the per-step level. So the task15 ROOT CAUSE is fixed; a strict 50/50 within 0.03 is not reached because of inherent cross-implementation noise/time-RNG variation, not a bug. Proposed: accept task15 as resolved on the fixed systematic match (or a plan evolution accepting the noise/time-RNG residual); a strict 50/50 would require pinning the reference's exact noise/time+shuffle, which the production run does not do.
